planets.name: Mercury
planets.fact: Mercury is the smallest planet and the closest to the Sun. It races around the Sun in just 88 Earth days.

planets.name: Venus
planets.fact: Venus is the hottest planet, even hotter than Mercury, and it spins backwards compared with most planets.

planets.name: Earth
planets.fact: Earth is the only planet we know that has life. Most of its surface is covered by water.

planets.name: Mars
planets.fact: Mars is the red planet. It has Olympus Mons, the tallest volcano in the solar system.

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.fact: Jupiter is the biggest planet. Its Great Red Spot is a storm that is bigger than Earth.

planets.name: Saturn
planets.look: the one with the big rings
planets.fact: Saturn has the biggest, brightest rings, made of ice and rock. It is so light for its size that it would float in a giant bathtub.

planets.name: Uranus
planets.fact: Uranus spins on its side, like a ball rolling around the Sun. It is a very cold, icy planet.

planets.name: Neptune
planets.fact: Neptune is the farthest planet from the Sun and has the fastest winds, much faster than a jet plane.

bonus.name: Moon
bonus.fact: The Moon travels around Earth. Astronauts bounce high on it because its gravity is so weak.
